verses.text: The king was living in his palace, and the LORD had given him peace from all his enemies around him.
Then the king said to Nathan the prophet, "Look, I am living in a palace made of cedar, but God's ark is kept in a tent."
Nathan said to the king, "Go and do whatever you have in mind, for the LORD is with you."
But that same night the LORD's message came to Nathan:
"Go and tell my servant David, 'This is what the LORD says: Are you the one to build me a house to live in?
I have not lived in a house from the day I brought the people of Israel up out of Egypt until today. I have moved from place to place in a tent, a holy tent.
Wherever I have gone with all the people of Israel, did I ever say to any of the leaders I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?"'
So now tell my servant David, 'This is what the LORD of Armies says: I took you from the fields where you followed the sheep, and made you ruler over my people Israel.
I have been with you wherever you went, and I have destroyed all your enemies in front of you. I will make your name great, like the names of the greatest people on earth.

I will give my people Israel a place of their own and plant them there, so they can live in their own home and not be disturbed any more. Wicked people will not crush them any more, as they did at the start,
ever since the time I appointed judges to lead my people Israel. I will give you peace from all your enemies. And the LORD tells you that he himself will build a house for you, a family of kings.
When your life is over and you die and are buried with your ancestors, I will raise up one of your own sons to be king after you, and I will make his kingdom strong.
He is the one who will build a house for my name, and I will make the throne of his kingdom last forever.
I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I will correct him with the rod, the way people correct their children, with blows from human hands.
But my faithful love will never be taken away from him, as I took it away from Saul, whom I removed to make way for you.
Your family and your kingdom will last forever before me. Your throne will stand firm forever.'"
Nathan told David everything the LORD had said and showed him in this vision.
Then King David went in and sat in front of the LORD. He said, "Who am I, Lord GOD, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?
And as if this was not enough for you, Lord GOD, you have also spoken about the future of your servant's family for a long time to come. Is this the way you usually deal with people, Lord GOD?
What more can I, David, say to you? You know your servant, Lord GOD.
Because of your promise, and because you wanted to, you have done all these great things and made them known to your servant.
That is why you are great, LORD God! There is no one like you, and there is no God except you. We have heard this with our own ears.

And what other nation on earth is like your people Israel? You, God, went out to rescue them to be your own people and to make your name known. You did great and wonderful things for your land in front of your people, whom you rescued from Egypt, from the nations and their gods.
You made your people Israel your very own people forever, and you, LORD, became their God.
Now, LORD God, keep forever the promise you made about your servant and his family. Do what you have said.
Then your name will be honoured forever, and people will say, 'The LORD of Armies is God over Israel!' And the family of your servant David will stand firm before you.
LORD of Armies, God of Israel, you have shown this to your servant and said, 'I will build a house for you.' That is why your servant has found the courage to pray this prayer to you.
Now, Lord GOD, you are God! Your words are true, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.
So now please bless your servant's family, so that it will continue forever before you. For you, Lord GOD, have spoken, and with your blessing the family of your servant will be blessed forever."
